form_saved_offline: No connection: the transaction is stored on your phone and will be sent once you’re back online
form_invalid: Amount, shop, category and recipient are required
month_no_member: No other members in this session
settle_body: Transfers so everyone ends the month with the same balance ({1} each), meal vouchers excluded.
settle_even: Everyone already has the same balance.
month_offline: No connection: showing the last data loaded on this phone
offline_rejected: Changes rejected by the server and dropped: {1}
error_offline: No internet connection: this action needs one
error_session_not_sent: Session {1} isn’t on the server yet: you can invite people once you’re online
subscription_invalid: A valid email, a name and a password of at least 8 characters are required
signup_intro: Welcome! Sign up to get started: your email and a password. If this email is already registered, enter its password to get your data back.
signup_name_intro: First time here! Check the name we’re suggesting — you can change it.
maintenance_message: The server is being updated and this version of the app can’t use it yet. Please try again later.
membership_visible_help: Other members can see your monthly totals
membership_alias_taken: That alias is already taken in this session
create_session_invalid: A session name is required (100 characters max)
create_session_conflict: That session name is already taken
session_settings_invalid: An alias is required (100 characters max)
invite_share_text: Join the session “{1}” on Budget: {2} (link valid until {3})
invite_scan_or_send: Scan the QR code or send the link
invite_qr_description: QR code for the invitation to the session “{1}”
sessions_empty: You’re not in any sessions yet. Create one, or join one with an invitation link.
join_link_invalid: That’s not a valid invitation link
join_expired: Invitation link is invalid or has expired
profile_password_invalid: Enter your current password and a new one of at least 8 characters
expense_delete_body: {1}, {2}: deleted permanently. A line created for another member stays with them.
session_delete_body: You won’t see it anymore and your budget will no longer be shared. The other members keep it; it’s deleted once no one is left. The transactions stay.
profile_delete_body: Permanently deletes your account, all your transactions and your settings. Your sessions are deleted for you; lines created for other members stay with them.
profile_delete_confirm_body: This can’t be undone. Enter your password to confirm.
error_not_configured: This version of the app has no server address
error_missing_api_token: This version of the app has no key: signing up isn’t possible
signup_password_help: At least 8 characters, asked only once
signup_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts, try again in a few minutes
session_global_hint: All my transactions, outside any session
tuto_entry_body: From the Add tab, enter an expense or income: amount, shop, category, recipient and date. If the shop is already known, its category fills in for you.
tuto_ticket_restaurant_body: Check Meal voucher when you pay with your voucher. You can enter more than your daily limit (€25 by default): the app counts €25 as the voucher and puts the rest on a separate line, paid with real money.
tuto_month_body: The Month tab shows your totals, the breakdown by category and your transactions. Pick any month from the list, or search for it (“Sept”, “2025”).
tuto_delete_expense_body: In the Month tab, tap the trash can after a line’s amount to delete it, then confirm. Only your own line goes: the line created for another member stays with them. You need a connection.
tuto_swipe_month_body: In the Month tab, swipe left to right for the previous month and right to left for the next one, just like the arrows.
tuto_swipe_session_body: In the Add and Month tabs, scroll to the bottom of the page and keep swiping up to reach the next page (the global page, then your sessions), or scroll to the top and keep swiping down for the previous one.
tuto_sessions_body: A session is a budget page shared with other people. Open the Sessions tab, tap Create, choose your alias and whether the other members can see your budget. Use makes a session your current page; Default page opens it when the app starts; the global page always shows all your transactions.
tuto_invitation_body: In the Sessions tab, tap Invite on a session: the app shows a QR code and a temporary link to share. Anyone who scans the QR code or opens the link joins the session, or they can paste the link after tapping Join.
tuto_balance_body: In a session’s Month tab, once every member (you included) shares their budget, an icon appears in the top bar. It lists the transfers that give everyone the same balance for the month.
tuto_delete_session_body: In the Sessions tab, tap the trash can at the top right of a session’s card. You’ll no longer see it and your budget will stop being shared; the other members keep it, and it disappears once no one is left. The transactions stay.
tuto_offline_body: No connection? Keep entering transactions: they’re stored on your phone and sent in order as soon as you’re back online. The Month tab shows the last data loaded, and an Offline badge lets you know your phone isn’t connected. Joining a session, inviting people, changing your password and signing up all need a connection.
tuto_settings_body: Tap the profile icon at the top right: the app’s language, light or dark mode and colors, then, by swiping over to the Account page, your email, your password change and account deletion.
tuto_delete_account_body: Tap the profile icon at the top right, swipe over to the Account page and tap Delete my account, then enter your password. Your account, transactions and settings are permanently deleted, along with any sessions you were the last member of. Lines created for other members stay with them. You need a connection.
error_recipient: Pick a session member or the merchant
expense_delete_recurrence: This transaction repeats. Is the repeat over or on hold?
tuto_recurrence_body: Rent, salary, subscription: in the entry form, tap Repeat, choose the period (every 3 days, every month, every year…) and confirm: the transaction is saved, then added again each time it comes due. In the Month tab, the arrows icon on a line (green = it repeats) edits or deletes the repeat; deleting the line asks whether the repeat is over or on hold until a date. You need a connection.
receipt_no_camera: No camera app on this phone
receipt_check: Check what was read, fill in the rest, then save.
receipt_nothing_read: Nothing could be read from this receipt: fill in the form by hand.
tuto_receipt_body: Tap the receipt icon in the Add tab to take a photo of a receipt or import pictures (several at once). The amount, shop, date and meal voucher are read on your phone and fill in the form: check them, fill in anything missing, then save. The next receipt follows.
tour_receipt_button_body: Take a photo of a receipt or import several pictures at once.
tour_receipt_fields_title: You always have the last word
tour_receipt_fields_body: The amount, shop, date and meal voucher fill in here. Check, complete, then save.
help_button: Help: guided tours of this page
tour_swipe_session_down_body: In the Add and Month tabs, swipe down to move to the next page of your budget. Here, it’s the page set up for this tour.
tour_swipe_session_up_body: Swipe up to go back to the previous page: here, your own page.
tour_swipe_month_next_body: In the Month tab, swipe right to left to see the next month.
tour_swipe_month_back_body: Swipe left to right to go back to the month before.
tour_session_default_body: Turn it on to open this page when the app starts.
tour_session_share_body: Other members only see your budget in this session if you share it.
tour_session_alias_body: Members see you under this name in this session. Tap Alias to change it.
tour_session_use_body: Use makes this session the page where you add and read. The global page always shows everything.
tour_app_page_body: The title is the budget page where you add and read: Global or one of your sessions. Tap it to switch pages.
tour_app_tabs_body: Add to enter a transaction, Month to read your totals and transactions, Sessions to share a budget page with others.
tour_app_help_body: On every page, this button lists the page’s guided tours, one per feature. Pick one to see it on the actual screen.
tour_app_profile_body: This icon opens the app’s settings and your account: language, colors, password and account deletion.
tour_entry_kind_body: Choose Expense for money going out, Income for money coming in (salary, refund). Income adds to your balance.
tour_entry_amount_body: Enter the amount in euros, with a comma or a period.
tour_entry_shop_body: Where you paid. As you type, shops you’ve already used are suggested, and a known shop fills in its category for you.
tour_entry_category_body: Groceries, rent, leisure… The Month tab adds up your transactions by category. Suggestions come from what you’ve already entered.
tour_entry_recipient_body: In a session only: who the transaction is for, among the members. Leave it as is if it’s for you.
tour_entry_date_body: Today by default. Tap it to pick another day, for a transaction you forgot.
tour_entry_detail_body: Optional: a note to remember what it was (gift for Anna, plane tickets…). It shows under the transaction in the Month tab.
tour_entry_save_body: Saves the transaction. With no connection, it’s kept on the phone and sent as soon as you’re back online.
tour_date_button_body: It shows the transaction’s day, today by default. Tap it to open the calendar.
tour_date_picker_body: Tap a day to pick it. The arrows change the month, and the year or the pencil let you type in a date.
tour_date_buttons_body: OK keeps the day you picked; Cancel closes the calendar and leaves the date as it was.
tour_receipt_banner_body: While receipts are being read, this banner tells you which one is in the form (1 of 3) and asks you to check what was read.
tour_receipt_actions_body: Skip leaves this receipt unsaved and moves on to the next one. Stop ends the review of the remaining ones.
tour_recurrence_button_body: For rent, salary or a subscription: this button saves the transaction and adds it again on a schedule you choose.
tour_recurrence_count_body: Every 1, every 3… Type the number, between 1 and 999. It goes with the unit chosen just below.
tour_recurrence_unit_body: Days, weeks, months or years. Every 1 month is a monthly rent; every 2 weeks, a biweekly paycheck.
tour_recurrence_next_body: The date the transaction is added again. It follows the period, but you can tap it to pick another day.
tour_recurrence_buttons_body: OK saves the transaction with its repeat; Cancel closes without saving anything. You need a connection.
tour_picker_button_body: The title of the Add and Month tabs is the page you’re working on. Tap it to open the list of your pages.
tour_picker_search_body: Type a few letters of a session’s name to narrow the list. Handy when you have lots of sessions.
tour_picker_list_body: Global shows all your transactions; each session is a page shared with others. New session… creates one.
tour_month_arrows_body: The arrows go to the previous or next month. Swiping left or right on the page does the same.
tour_month_totals_body: Expenses, income and the month’s balance. Meal vouchers aren’t included; the balance with them is shown in small print below.
tour_month_categories_body: The month’s transactions added up by category, so you can see at a glance where the money went.
tour_month_operations_body: Each line: day, shop, category, recipient and amount. On a line that’s already saved, the arrows icon sets a repeat and the trash can deletes it.
tour_month_members_body: In a session: the other members, with their balance when they share their budget. On the global page, there’s nothing here.
tour_monthpick_button_body: The button with the month and year opens the list of months, so you can jump straight to any of them.
tour_monthpick_search_body: Type a month or a year (“Sept”, “2025”) to narrow the list.
tour_monthpick_list_body: Three months ahead and six years back. Tap one to view it; the current month is marked.
tour_delete_expense_confirm_body: Nothing is deleted right away: the dialog repeats the shop and amount so you can check it’s the right line.
tour_delete_expense_recurrence_body: If the line repeats, choose: it’s over for good, or on hold until a day you pick.
tour_delete_expense_buttons_body: Delete removes the line for good (you need a connection); Cancel closes the dialog and keeps everything.
tour_expense_recurrence_icon_body: Gray: this line doesn’t repeat, tap to make it repeat. Green: it repeats, tap to edit or stop it.
tour_expense_recurrence_dialog_body: Set the period (every 1 month…), the next one and, if needed, a pause until a certain day. It’s the same window as in the entry form.
tour_expense_recurrence_delete_body: The trash can at the top deletes only the repeat: the line itself, and the ones it already added, stay.
tour_expense_recurrence_buttons_body: OK saves your changes; Cancel closes the window without changing anything. You need a connection.
tour_balance_share_body: The amount each member should end the month with so that everyone has the same balance (meal vouchers excluded).
tour_balance_transfers_body: The transfers to make: each line says who sends how much to whom. Do them in your banking app, outside Budget.
tour_sessions_join_body: Got an invitation link? Tap Join and paste it. If you scan the QR code or open the link, the app does it for you.
tour_create_button_body: Create starts a new session: a budget page you can share with the people you invite.
tour_create_name_body: A name the members will recognize (Holiday, Flatmates…). It has to be unique.
tour_create_alias_body: The name the other members see you under in this session. You can change it later from the session’s card.
tour_create_share_body: On: others can see your transactions in this session. Off: they only see that you’re a member. You can change it at any time.
tour_create_submit_body: Creates the session and makes it your current page. You can then invite people from its card in the Sessions tab.
tour_join_button_body: Opens a window where you paste the invitation link you received by message or email.
tour_join_link_body: Paste the whole link. If it isn’t an invitation from the app, a message says so and Join stays grayed out. It expires after a while.
tour_join_intro_body: The screen names the session you’re invited to. Make sure it’s the right one before joining.
tour_join_choices_body: Pick the alias members will see, and whether you share your budget with them. You can change both later.
tour_join_submit_body: Gets you into the session: it appears in your Sessions tab and in the page list. You need a connection.
tour_alias_field_body: The members of this session will see you under this name. Choose one that isn’t already taken in the session.
tour_alias_buttons_body: Save applies the new alias right away; Cancel closes the window and keeps the old one.
tour_invite_qr_body: Another phone scans it with its camera and opens the invitation. It’s drawn on your phone; nothing is sent to any service.
tour_invite_link_body: The same invitation as a link, valid for a limited time. The icon copies it so you can paste it into a message.
tour_invite_share_body: Opens Android’s share sheet: WhatsApp, SMS, email… with a ready-made message that includes the link.
tour_delete_session_confirm_body: The dialog explains what happens: you leave the session, the others keep it, and the transactions stay. Delete confirms, Cancel keeps everything.
tour_settings_language_body: Pick the app’s language from the list: each one is written in its own language. The change is immediate.
tour_settings_mode_body: Light, dark, or your phone’s mode. Dark is easier on the eyes in the evening.
tour_settings_palette_body: Choose the app’s color palette. Each swatch previews the colors, in the light or dark mode you use.
tour_account_tab_body: Swipe left or tap this tab to leave the settings and see your account: who you are, your password and how to delete it.
tour_account_identity_body: Your name and your account’s email address. You use this email to sign back in on a new phone.
tour_account_password_body: Enter your current password, then the new one, and tap the button under the fields. You need a connection.
tour_delete_account_password_body: Deletion is permanent, so the app asks for your password to make sure it’s you. A wrong one is rejected and nothing is deleted.
tour_delete_account_buttons_body: Delete permanently removes your account, transactions and settings (you need a connection); Cancel changes nothing.
recurrence_times: Total number of times (empty: no end)
recurrence_times_help: This transaction included: 3 = it appears 3 times in all.
tour_recurrence_times_body: Empty: it repeats forever. Enter 3 and it appears 3 times in all, this one included, then stops on its own.
web_video_unsupported: This browser can’t play the video.
